name: EGB
source:
The story of a man who experimented with the spawn of the elusive Emerald Cockroach Bee... Today he researches at the home of Ms. Shibayama... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE081991.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
一名男子曾用神秘難尋的「綠寶石蟑螂蜂」幼體進行實驗……今天，他來到柴山女士家中展開研究……
